subject: Investigate search arm 0%: notes not appearing in /search results
description: The agent-memory benchmark search arm scores 0% on both LoCoMo and LongMemEval pilots. Investigation in task 59fc18e1-744e-4f7a-9093-a8e12d43087b/31 found: notes ARE ingested correctly (our-way arm retrieves them via DAG context edges, e.g. note:note-mqizg48a982). But GET /search?q=...&workspace=C:/Temp/zonoid-pilot-bench/fx-locomo-001 returns ONLY probe stub nodes (kind=task), never the ingested session notes. The stub filter in _is_session_note_hit (probe_runner.py) correctly rejects these, leaving hit_keys=[]. The prior /30 fix filtered stubs that appeared in results — but this is a different issue: the notes are NOT appearing at all. Check whether the /search endpoint indexes notes from workspace-specific namespaces or only from the global workspace. The daemon may not embed/index notes posted with a bench-specific workspace path. Files: bench/agent-memory/probe_runner.py run_search(), zonoid_lifecycle.py search(), and the daemon's /search endpoint implementation.
